assign.request: build some team management ux, maybe some game ux. make a single root page (maybe... /imagine/page.js), and turn that page into an experience. ask minions to consider what type of navigation and paging structure (real files vs dynamic, generated, etc). consider exploring path-based storage, so any page could utilize its path as its id, allowing any page to save/load data.
steps: read the system (columns, roles, panels, uses exemplars)
the root — /imagine/ as a full-height columns experience
team/ — roster, person, assignments, board, cross-column via is:topic
path-based storage helper + one real persisted thing

assign.now: built the root, team and game; probing headless

log.msg: root = a small rail + a large Start column (default) whose cards ARE the nav; team = board(large) > roster(small) > person; game = run rail > realm rail > room(large). Board is the PARENT of the roster because a default column stands down when a sibling routes - the thing that must stay visible has to be up the tree, not across it.

CORE FINDING (not fixed, out of fence): a `default` column may never be a PARENT. Page.css hides `.page-column-pages:has(> .page:is(.active-page,.active-ancestor)) > .page.default` - a routed default page satisfies that test itself and hides its own subtree. Measured: a board-beside-roster draft drew 2 columns at /imagine/team/roster/ada/ instead of 4. Shipped shape: whatever must stay visible is UP the tree; whatever arrives by `default` is a leaf.

hug TRIED and rejected for nav rails: realm rail hugged to 128px (The Verge) vs 183px (The Hollow, one row reads 'needs the brass lamp') at 1920 - the rail's width depends on which sibling you opened and the column beside it moves 55px on every change. hug wants a column whose content width is constant. Reverted to small; finding written into /imagine/readme.md.

CROSS-COLUMN MEASURED (headless 1920): 3 rail clicks -> picks 1/2/3, updates 1/3/5 (a deselect between each), board label follows, hops 2 from board to topic. One lane move from the person column -> moves 1, updates 6, board redrew, rail load 5 pts -> 0 pts. Zero console errors.

STORAGE MEASURED: game key lew42:/imagine/game/ = {"found":["verge/quarry","hollow/cistern"],"carried":["lamp"]} identical before and after reload; cistern stayed open, HUD 0/9 -> 2/9. Team key kept lanes + density:compact + sort:load across a reload; rail still ordered by load. Widths 400/1920/3440: 4 columns at /imagine/team/ada/ = 224+224+640+832 (1920) and 252+252+720+1152 (3440); no accidental scrollers at 1920 or 3440, none at 400 beyond core's own horizontal row.

assign.outcome:
**A place, not a doc** — `/imagine/` is a full-height column row from the first paint: a 14em rail, a `Start` column whose preview cards are the nav, and everything below it — a person, a lane, a room three realms down — another column in the same row.

![](root-1920.png)

- [/imagine/](/imagine/) — the root. Rail + `Start` (the `default` column); linked from the homepage's *Also here* line.
- [/imagine/team/](/imagine/team/) — roster rail, person, assignments, and **a board that follows the selection**. Two controls (density, sort) instead of a page per state.
- [/imagine/game/](/imagine/game/) — three realms, nine rooms, three things to carry; an exit is a link to a sibling, so walking sideways swaps the deepest column in place.
- [/imagine/readme/](/imagine/readme/) — the findings: real-files-vs-generated, path storage, and the `page.store()` proposal.
- `public/imagine/store.js` — `store(page)`, keyed on `page.url`.

![](team-1920.png)

**Cross-column, measured** (headless 1920): three rail clicks -> `picks 1/2/3`, `updates 1/3/5`, board label follows, `hops: 2` from the board to the topic. One lane move in the person column -> `moves 1`, board redrawn, rail load `5 pts -> 0 pts`. **Storage, measured**: `lew42:/imagine/game/` = `{"found":["verge/quarry","hollow/cistern"],"carried":["lamp"]}` identical before and after a reload, cistern still open, HUD `0/9 -> 2/9`; the team kept lanes, `density:compact` and `sort:load`. Zero console errors at 400 / 1920 / 3440.

![](game-1920.png)

**Two findings for core (untouched — out of fence).** A `default` column may never be a **parent**: a routed `default` page satisfies `.page-column-pages:has(> .page:is(.active-page,.active-ancestor)) > .page.default` itself and hides its own subtree (a board-beside-roster draft drew 2 columns instead of 4). And `hug` is wrong for a nav rail — the realm rail hugged to 128px vs 183px depending on which sibling was open, moving the column beside it 55px per change.

**Left:** `fill` unused (a 4-lane board at 3440 would stretch to 554px lanes — `large` is the right word); the preview-card restyle is S-preview's; at 400 the row snaps to the deepest column, so opening a person lands on her board.
